dedupe_keys.name: amsterdam park and ride occupancy data

description: Gemeente Amsterdam publishes a CSV file of Park-and-Ride occupancy observations for Amsterdam through the ACUMEN collection. The source states that the observations were collected from the Amsterdam open-data portal between 16 September 2025 and 6 January 2026. This is a bounded historical occupancy dataset describing transport-interchange use. It can supply observed demand and utilisation inputs for parking-capacity and multimodal transport modelling. Zenodo provides free access under CC BY 4.0. A limitation is that the one-sentence source description does not enumerate parking sites, column names, measurement units, sample intervals or missing-data treatment. The dataset therefore does not establish citywide completeness or current parking availability. The existing Amsterdam EV-planning dataset aggregates mobility and parking-capacity information from 2017–2019; its described period and contents differ from these later occupancy observations. No numerical occupancy records were downloaded or checked.
